task_definition.task_description: Check for any available coupons for my account user_1234, then find some trending alternatives to the black Sony XM5 headphones. From the recommendations, please select one silver Sony WH-1000XM5 and put it on hold for me. After that, confirm the order for that reservation, analyze the confirmation status, and finally get the current UTC time to send it to me as a high-priority alert.

user_input.query: Hi there! Could you please check for any available coupons for my account, user_1234? From the recommendations you find, please select one silver Sony WH-1000XM5 and put a quantity of 1 on hold for me. After that, I’d like you to confirm the order for that reservation using my paypal payment_method. Once that's processed, please analyze the confirmation status to make sure everything went through correctly. Finally, get the current UTC time and send it over to me as a high-priority alert.
